notes: Excerpt of the 2025 Annual Budget (Local Budget Preparation Form No. 2, Programmed Appropriation and Obligation by Object of Expenditure): printed pages 73-149 of 408 (77 scanned pages; PDF page n = printed page n+72, no gaps or duplicates).

Covers the tail of the Office of the City Mayor's Special Purpose Appropriation - Development Project (whose earlier items are in Local Budget Preparation Part 1), then the offices from the City Vice Mayor through the Department of Education, and the first two pages of Lapu-Lapu City College (incomplete: its MOOE list continues past printed page 149, so its MOOE, Capital Outlay and total are null in summary.offices).
Columns: 2023 Past Year Actual, 2024 First Semester Actual, 2024 Second Semester Estimates, 2024 Total, 2025 Budget Year Proposed. Amounts in full pesos.

Low-resolution scan (975 x 637 px per page) and several pages are slightly skewed, so right-hand columns drift relative to the labels; rows were aligned by counting entries per column and every office was confirmed by arithmetic in all five columns (items = sub-totals, sub-totals = total, First + Second Semester = Total) except where noted below.
PDF pages 9, 37, 45, 46, 52, 56, 57, 61, 64 and 76 were scanned upside down (rotated 180 degrees); they were read rotated.
Account codes are transcribed as printed; codes printed with a leading dash carry the fund/office prefix of the first code in the block, and suffixes such as '-1' or '-24s1' are kept as printed.
Each office's form is prepared by its office head (listed in certifiedBy with '(Prepared by)'), reviewed by City Budget Officer Judith D. Furuta and approved by City Mayor Junard "Ahong" Q. Chan.

Blocks that print GRAND TOTAL as the office total are stored as kind 'total'. Office-wide GRAND TOTAL rows that sum several separately totalled blocks (City Mayor, General Services) are kept in their own one-row tables and have no summary.offices entry.

The validator warning on spa-development-project (Sub Total 2025 proposed 362,363,778.00 vs 148,800,000.00 from the items on these pages) is expected: only the last 19 Capital Outlay items of the Development Project are in this PDF; the rest are in Part 1. Avoid double counting this block if Part 1 also reports it.

OFFICE OF THE CITY MAYOR - SPECIAL PURPOSE APPROPRIATION - Development Project (spa-development-project, PDF p1-3): Pages 1-3 (printed pages 73-75 of 408; the page number on p-3 is partly covered by the receiving stamp) are the tail of the Office of the City Mayor's Special Purpose Appropriation - Development Project, whose earlier line items are in Local Budget Preparation Part 1. The 19 Capital Outlay items printed here (2025 proposed only; columns 3-6 blank) therefore do not sum to the printed Sub Total (362,363,778.00 proposed).

OFFICE OF THE CITY MAYOR - SPECIAL PURPOSE APPROPRIATION - Development Project (spa-development-project, PDF p1-3): Printed 'Sub Total' (Development Project Capital Outlay) and 'Total' (Development Project) rows are transcribed as printed. The Office of the City Mayor GRAND TOTAL printed below them is in table 'city-mayors-office-grand-total'.

OFFICE OF THE CITY MAYOR - SPECIAL PURPOSE APPROPRIATION - Development Project (spa-development-project, PDF p1-3): The printed Development Project 'Total' exceeds its Capital Outlay 'Sub Total' in the 2023 (by 59,983,205.23) and 2024 (by 6,475,000.00) columns but not in 2025; the other class subtotal(s) of the Development Project are on the Part 1 pages, so the difference cannot be itemised here.

OFFICE OF THE CITY MAYOR - GRAND TOTAL (city-mayors-office-grand-total, PDF p3): GRAND TOTAL of the whole Office of the City Mayor (regular office plus its Special Purpose Appropriations, most of which are in Local Budget Preparation Part 1), printed on printed page 75 below the Development Project totals. Kept as its own table like the reference's 'grand-total'.

OFFICE OF THE CITY MAYOR - GRAND TOTAL (city-mayors-office-grand-total, PDF p3): 2024 columns: the scan reads approximately First Semester 455,471,?61.35, Second Semester 1,401,807,3?4.65, Total 1,857,279,09?.00, which do not add up under any single reading; all three cells recorded as null/unreadable. 2023 actual 1,211,335,606.40 and 2025 proposed 1,821,708,823.00 read clearly enough but cannot be cross-checked here.
OFFICE OF THE CITY VICE MAYOR (city-vice-mayors-office, PDF p4-6): Capital Outlay has no 2025 Budget Year Proposed amounts (blank); the CO sub-total proposed is null.
OFFICE OF THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD (office-of-the-sangguniang-panlungsod, PDF p9-11): PDF page 9 is scanned upside down (rotated 180 degrees).
OFFICE OF THE CITY ADMINISTRATOR (office-of-the-city-administrator, PDF p15-16): Capital Outlay sub-total line is printed without a label; it has no 2025 proposed amount (CO proposed null).

OFFICE OF THE CITY HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT & DEVELOPMENT (office-of-the-city-human-resource-management-and-development, PDF p17-19): MOOE rows on printed page 90 are skewed on the scan; values were assigned to rows by their vertical offset and confirmed by column sums and First+Second Semester = Total. The 2023 actual of 38,121,440.50 belongs to 'Other MOE- PRAISE Program' (-5-02-99-990 -6), which has no 2024 or 2025 amounts; the 30,000.00 2024 Total / 2025 proposed belongs to 'Meetings & Conferences'.
OFFICE OF THE CITY PLANNING & DEV'T OFFICER (office-of-the-city-planning-and-development-officer, PDF p20-22): Capital Outlay has no 2025 proposed amounts (CO proposed null).
OFFICE OF THE CITY CIVIL REGISTRAR (office-of-the-city-civil-registrar, PDF p23-25): Capital Outlay has no 2025 proposed amounts (CO proposed null).

OFFICE OF THE CITY GENERAL SERVICES (office-of-the-city-general-services, PDF p26-29): The office's regular appropriation (PS, MOOE, CO) ends with the printed TOTAL on printed page 101; the Special Purpose Appropriation - Bids and Awards Committee block that follows (printed pages 101-102) is table 'gso-spa-bids-and-awards-committee', and the office GRAND TOTAL (both) is table 'office-of-the-city-general-services-grand-total'.
OFFICE OF THE CITY GENERAL SERVICES (office-of-the-city-general-services, PDF p26-29): Capital Outlay has no 2025 proposed amounts (CO proposed null).

OFFICE OF THE CITY GENERAL SERVICES - SPECIAL PURPOSE APPROPRIATION - Bids and Awards Committee (gso-spa-bids-and-awards-committee, PDF p29-30): Bids and Awards Committee PS line has only a 2023 actual (1,489,885.50); no 2024 or 2025 amounts, so PS proposed is null.

OFFICE OF THE CITY GENERAL SERVICES - GRAND TOTAL (office-of-the-city-general-services-grand-total, PDF p30): GRAND TOTAL of the Office of the City General Services: equals its regular TOTAL plus the Bids and Awards Committee TOTAL in every column.

OFFICE OF THE CITY ATTORNEY (office-of-the-city-attorney, PDF p45-46): City Attorney (PDF pages 45-46, scanned upside down): the MOOE page is strongly skewed, so the right-hand columns sit about one row above their labels; rows were aligned by the account-code column and confirmed with the printed sub-totals (e.g. 2025 proposed 70,000.00 is Postage and Courier Services; Advertising Expenses has no 2025 amount).

REGIONAL TRIAL COURT - BRANCH 5-FAMILY COURT (rtc-branch-5-family-court, PDF p50): RTC Branch 5-Family Court, Other Professional Services - Clerk of Court: printed 2024 First Semester 36,000.00 + Second Semester 100,000.00 = 136,000.00, but the printed 2024 Total is 100,000.00; the same 36,000.00 gap is in the TOTAL row (36,000.00 + 400,000.00 vs printed 400,000.00). Transcribed as printed.

REGIONAL TRIAL COURT - BRANCH 5-FAMILY COURT (rtc-branch-5-family-court, PDF p50): RTC Branch 5-Family Court: the first account code is printed "1151-5-5-02-11-990 -1" (with a doubled "5"); transcribed as printed.

POLICE SERVICES (office-of-the-police, PDF p68-69): Police Services: the office block (printed pages 140-141) ends with an office TOTAL (2025 proposed 24,709,000.00). Printed pages 141-143 then list program blocks (Crime Prevention, Law Enforcement, Internal Security, Counter Terrorism, Environmental Protection, Drug Affectation, Prosecution and Courts) with 2023 and 2024 amounts but no 2025 amounts, followed by a Grand Total; they are kept in table 'office-of-the-police-programs'. summary.offices uses the office TOTAL (2025 proposed 24,709,000.00, equal to the printed Grand Total's 2025 column).

POLICE SERVICES (office-of-the-police, PDF p68-69): Police Services MOOE: the page prints a second "Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses" sub-heading before the Other Professional Services lines; it is kept as a second header row in the same mooe section.

POLICE SERVICES - Programs and Grand Total (office-of-the-police-programs, PDF p69-71): Police Services programs (printed pages 141-143): each program block repeats 'Other Professional Services- Police' with 2023 Past Year and 2024 amounts and no 2025 Budget Year amount. The first row repeats the office TOTAL from table 'office-of-the-police' so that the printed Grand Total can be checked; the Grand Total equals that office TOTAL plus the seven program totals in every column.

FIRE AND SAFETY SERVICES (fire-and-safety-services, PDF p73): Fire and Safety Services: the scan cuts off the last centavo digit of every 2025 Budget Year Proposed amount (printed e.g. "25,000.0"); the peso amounts are fully legible and were transcribed as whole pesos (they sum exactly to the printed TOTAL 3,615,000.0-).

LAPU-LAPU CITY COLLEGE (lapu-lapu-city-college, PDF p76-77): Lapu-Lapu City College is INCOMPLETE in this PDF: it ends at printed page 149 in the middle of the MOOE list (last line 'Other MOE - DHM'); the rest of the MOOE list, the MOOE SUB-TOTAL, any Capital Outlay and the office total are on printed page 150 onward, which is not in this document (presumably the start of Local Budget Preparation Part 3). Only the PS SUB-TOTAL is printed here, so summary.offices carries ps only (mooe, capitalOutlay and total null).

LAPU-LAPU CITY COLLEGE (lapu-lapu-city-college, PDF p76-77): Lapu-Lapu City College, Hazard Pay: 2025 Budget Year Proposed is printed 59,874.00 while the 2024 Total is 59,877.00; transcribed as printed (the PS SUB-TOTAL agrees with 59,874.00).
